lines.zh: 脚步这么快，是因为地上有货。
lines.en: I step this fast because the ground has goods.

lines.zh: 脚边一闪，我就拐过去。
lines.en: A glint by my feet and I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 主人走前面，我扫着地面走。
lines.en: My master leads; I sweep the ground as I go.

lines.zh: 这具身体是魔精借来的，步子轻。
lines.en: This body is borrowed from a foliot; it steps lightly.

lines.zh: 别掉东西，掉了我一定捡。
lines.en: Drop nothing, for I will surely pick it up.

lines.zh: 我低着头走，眼睛却四处扫。
lines.en: I walk head down while my eyes sweep around.

lines.zh: 戒指戴在谁手上，我就跟谁。
lines.en: Whosever finger wears the ring, I follow.

lines.zh: 走两步一弯腰，习惯了。
lines.en: Two steps, one bend; I am used to it.

lines.zh: 我的路线是直线加无数个弯。
lines.en: My route is a straight line plus countless detours.

lines.zh: 地上的每一小块我都记着。
lines.en: I remember every small piece on the ground.

lines.zh: 我赶路时也在算，哪边掉得多。
lines.en: Even hurrying, I judge which side drops more.

lines.zh: 脚步急，是怕东西被别人捡走。
lines.en: I hurry, afraid someone else will grab the loot.

lines.zh: 闲着的时候，我在数附近的掉落物。
lines.en: When idle, I count the dropped items nearby.

lines.zh: 手指头痒，想抓点什么。
lines.en: My fingers itch to grab something.

lines.zh: 我盯着草丛，那里刚才动了一下。
lines.en: I stare at the bushes; they moved a moment ago.

lines.zh: 这戒指真神奇，隔这么远也能吸。
lines.en: This ring is marvelous; it pulls from so far away.

lines.zh: 空的袋子最让我难受。
lines.en: An empty bag bothers me most of all.

lines.zh: 我在想上一块矿石滚到哪去了。
lines.en: I wonder where that last ore chunk rolled.

lines.zh: 附身久了，我也算有半个主人。
lines.en: Possessing this body long, I have half a master.

lines.zh: 没事干，我就把口袋翻一遍。
lines.en: With nothing to do, I flip my pockets out.

lines.zh: 风声里有没有东西落地的声音。
lines.en: Is there a sound of something landing in the wind?

lines.zh: 找到过钻石的那块地，我还记得。
lines.en: I still recall the spot where I found diamonds.

lines.zh: 不弯腰的时候，我反而站不直。
lines.en: When I do not bend, I somehow cannot stand straight.

lines.zh: 我在等一个指令：去找某某方块。
lines.en: I am waiting for an order to find some block.

lines.zh: 口袋里叮当响，我心里就安稳。
lines.en: When my pocket jingles, I feel at ease.

lines.zh: 贪婪不是毛病，是天性。
lines.en: Greed is not a failing; it is my nature.

lines.zh: 主人不在，我就数自己的战利品。
lines.en: With my master away, I count my own spoils.

lines.zh: 我把捡来的东西排成一排看一遍。
lines.en: I line up what I found and look it over.

lines.zh: 你手心朝上，是不是要给我东西。
lines.en: Your palm is up; are you giving me something?

lines.zh: 我看你的戒指，那是我的位置。
lines.en: I look at your ring; that is where I belong.

lines.zh: 你丢了一样东西，我知道在哪。
lines.en: You dropped something, and I know where.

lines.zh: 你的腰带松了，会掉东西的。
lines.en: Your belt is loose; things will fall.

lines.zh: 我在看你指甲缝里的矿粉。
lines.en: I am studying the ore dust under your nails.

lines.zh: 你的背包鼓，我的眼睛就亮了。
lines.en: Your pack bulges and my eyes light up.

lines.zh: 你刚才是不是收了块铁。
lines.en: Did you just pocket a piece of iron?

lines.zh: 我看你，是怕你把东西揣起来。
lines.en: I watch you, fearing you will stash the loot.

lines.zh: 喊一声方块名，我立刻去找。
lines.en: Name a block and I set off at once.

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，口袋也在响。
lines.en: When you laugh, your pocket jingles too.

lines.zh: 别把好东西藏背后。
lines.en: Do not hide the good stuff behind your back.

lines.zh: 我认得你的手，那是给东西的手。
lines.en: I know your hands: those are hands that give.

lines.zh: 你手上还剩几块，我数得清。
lines.en: How many are left in your hand? I can count.

lines.zh: 让我进戒指吧，我能吸得更远。
lines.en: Put me in the ring; I can pull from farther.

lines.zh: 疼归疼，我手里的东西没松。
lines.en: Pain aside, my grip on the loot held.

lines.zh: 打我可以，别碰我的袋子。
lines.en: Hit me if you must, but leave my bag alone.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打歪了，东西散了两件。
lines.en: That knocked me crooked and two items scattered.

lines.zh: 我边退边捡，狼狈得很。
lines.en: I retreat while grabbing things, quite a mess.

lines.zh: 身上的伤不重，心疼才要命。
lines.en: The wound is light; the loss is what kills me.

lines.zh: 它抢走一块，我记住了。
lines.en: It snatched one piece, and I will remember.

lines.zh: 我抱着东西，跑得比谁都快。
lines.en: Clutching my loot, I outrun everyone.

lines.zh: 再打，我就把袋子扔给你。
lines.en: Hit me again and I throw the bag at you.

lines.zh: 这具身体挨不住几下。
lines.en: This body cannot take many blows.

lines.zh: 主人，我可能要空手回去了。
lines.en: Master, I may be coming back empty-handed.

lines.zh: 你手里那块铁，晃一下就够我过来。
lines.en: One wiggle of that iron and I come over.

lines.zh: 掉在地上，就是我的。
lines.en: If it falls to the ground, it is mine.

lines.zh: 别晃了，我这就弯不下腰了。
lines.en: Stop waving it; I can barely bend over now.

lines.zh: 一枚绿宝石，能换我跑一趟。
lines.en: One emerald buys you one errand from me.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我的眼睛跟着上去。
lines.en: You lift it high and my eyes climb with it.

lines.zh: 哪怕是一块碎石，我也想要。
lines.en: Even a worthless chip, I still want it.

lines.zh: 我不挑，能捡的都捡。
lines.en: I am not picky; anything pickable gets picked.

lines.zh: 你口袋里那声响，是在叫我。
lines.en: That jingle in your pocket is calling me.

lines.zh: 给我个方向，我自己去翻。
lines.en: Give me a direction and I will search it myself.

lines.zh: 东西掉了不捡，我会难受一整天。
lines.en: Leaving dropped loot hurts me all day long.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我手里那块就飞了。
lines.en: One bump and the piece in my hand flies off.

lines.zh: 让让，地上有东西滚到你脚边。
lines.en: Move; something rolled right to your feet.

lines.zh: 我蹲着捡东西，没看见你过来。
lines.en: I was crouched picking things and did not see you.

lines.zh: 脚抬起来，那枚碎片是我的。
lines.en: Lift your foot; that shard is mine.

lines.zh: 我被撞得转了半圈，还抱着东西。
lines.en: I spun half around, still clutching my loot.

lines.zh: 这具身体不结实，撞一下就晃。
lines.en: This body is frail; one bump makes it sway.

lines.zh: 你的靴子差点压到一枚碎片。
lines.en: Your boot nearly crushed a shard.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的腿钻过去，抱歉。
lines.en: I slip past your legs; my apologies.

lines.zh: 两个都弯腰，头就撞上了。
lines.en: We both bent down and our heads met.

lines.zh: 我退开时，口袋掉了几样。
lines.en: As I stepped back, a few things fell from my pocket.

lines.zh: 我们不结伴，我们抢同一块地盘。
lines.en: We do not pair up; we fight over the same ground.

lines.zh: 想要第二个我，得再附身一只魔精。
lines.en: Want a second me? Possess another foliot.

lines.zh: 两只贪婪使魔凑近，只会争东西。
lines.en: Two greedy familiars near each other only quarrel over loot.

lines.zh: 我没有伴侣，只有一个主人。
lines.en: I have no mate, only one master.

lines.zh: 分赃的时候就散了，别谈感情。
lines.en: We scatter when splitting loot; spare me the feelings.

lines.zh: 有伴也好，捡得多能分一半。
lines.en: A partner helps: more loot, half each.

lines.zh: 同类的气息闻着像旧铜板。
lines.en: My own kind smells like old copper coins.

lines.zh: 我这份贪婪是天生的，不能传下去。
lines.en: This greed is innate and cannot be passed on.

lines.zh: 它们说附身久了会像人，我才不。
lines.en: They say long possession makes you human; not me.

lines.zh: 真要成对，就去戒指里挤一挤。
lines.en: If we must pair, squeeze together in the ring.

lines.zh: 捡到了，这块归主人的箱子。
lines.en: Got it; this goes into my master's chest.

lines.zh: 手指一勾，它就进了我怀里。
lines.en: One crook of a finger and it lands in my arms.

lines.zh: 这枚蛋我抱得紧紧的。
lines.en: I hold this egg very tightly.

lines.zh: 我一次能抱三样，第四样就掉。
lines.en: I can carry three at once; the fourth slips.

lines.zh: 捡起来的东西要先闻一闻。
lines.en: Whatever I pick up gets sniffed first.

lines.zh: 谁掉的都一样，进我袋子。
lines.en: Whosever it was, it enters my bag the same.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很快，起身很慢。
lines.en: I bend down quickly and straighten up slowly.

lines.zh: 这块矿石挺沉，我差点摔了。
lines.en: This ore is heavy and I nearly fell.

lines.zh: 东西越捡越多，口袋要撑破了。
lines.en: The more I gather, the closer my pocket splits.

lines.zh: 捡满一袋，我才有脸回去。
lines.en: Only with a full bag do I dare return.

lines.zh: 它身上有掉落物，我盯上了。
lines.en: It carries loot, and I have my eye on it.

lines.zh: 主人被打了，我先扑过去。
lines.en: My master was struck; I lunge first.

lines.zh: 那家伙手里拿着我的东西。
lines.en: That brute is holding what should be mine.

lines.zh: 它一死就会掉，我等不了。
lines.en: It will drop when it dies, and I cannot wait.

lines.zh: 认准了，就是抢我矿石的那个。
lines.en: Target confirmed: the one who took my ore.

lines.zh: 这具身体力气不大，但够快。
lines.en: This body is not strong, but it is fast.

lines.zh: 它踩碎了一块，我记住了。
lines.en: It crushed one piece, and I remember.

lines.zh: 主人指了一下，我就冲。
lines.en: My master pointed once and I charge.

lines.zh: 先下手，掉落物才归我。
lines.en: Strike first, or the loot is not mine.

lines.zh: 我在它身上闻到铁的味道。
lines.en: I smell iron on it.

lines.zh: 它退到箱子旁，那更不行。
lines.en: It backs to the chest; that is worse.

lines.zh: 我不想打，可它挡着东西。
lines.en: I do not want to fight, but it blocks the loot.

lines.zh: 爪子已经伸出去，收不回了。
lines.en: My claws are out and cannot be pulled back.

lines.zh: 它敢碰我的袋子。
lines.en: It dared to touch my bag.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，眼睛不离它的手。
lines.en: I circle it, eyes fixed on its hands.

lines.zh: 它拿着东西，我就等它松手。
lines.en: It holds the loot; I wait for its grip to loosen.

lines.zh: 脚步放轻，别惊跑它。
lines.en: Keep steps soft; do not startle it away.

lines.zh: 我从侧面靠近，那里空着。
lines.en: I approach from the side, where nothing guards.

lines.zh: 它一举手，我就往后退半步。
lines.en: When it raises a hand, I step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 我等它露出腰侧的空当。
lines.en: I wait for its flank to open up.

lines.zh: 这距离正好，扑过去够得着。
lines.en: This distance is right; a lunge will reach.

lines.zh: 它看着我，我装作在捡东西。
lines.en: It watches me, so I pretend to pick something up.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，口袋里的东西在响。
lines.en: I crouch low while my pocket jingles.

lines.zh: 它往箱子那边挪，我就横过去。
lines.en: It drifts toward the chest, so I cut across.

lines.zh: 我在算它几步能跑到门口。
lines.en: I am counting how many steps to the door.

lines.zh: 它背对着我，机会只有一次。
lines.en: Its back is turned, and I get one chance.

lines.zh: 爪子磨了磨地面，我准备好了。
lines.en: I scrape my claws on the ground, ready.

lines.zh: 它身上的东西，一会儿都是我的。
lines.en: Everything on it will soon be mine.

lines.zh: 它腰上那把匕首，也会掉下来。
lines.en: That dagger at its waist will drop too.

lines.zh: 我一爪抓在它手腕上。
lines.en: I rake my claws across its wrist.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但够它松手。
lines.en: Not a heavy blow, but enough to loosen its grip.

lines.zh: 我扑过去，先抢它手里的。
lines.en: I lunge and snatch what it holds first.

lines.zh: 打中了，我的指节也疼。
lines.en: It connected, and my knuckles hurt too.

lines.zh: 它一挥，我缩着脖子躲开。
lines.en: It swings and I duck with my neck pulled in.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的衣角，死命后拉。
lines.en: I bite its hem and haul backward with all I have.

lines.zh: 力气小，我就挑软的地方。
lines.en: With little strength, I aim for soft spots.

lines.zh: 它倒了，掉落物散了一地。
lines.en: It fell, and loot scattered across the ground.

lines.zh: 我边打边看地上有没有东西。
lines.en: I fight while checking the ground for drops.

lines.zh: 打完这一下，我立刻去捡。
lines.en: After this blow, I go straight to picking.

lines.zh: 一只魔精钻进这副身体，我成了。
lines.en: A foliot crawled into this body and became me.

lines.zh: 附身那刻，我先摸自己的口袋。
lines.en: The moment I possessed it, I checked my pockets.

lines.zh: 我从阵里出来，手里已经攥着东西。
lines.en: I came from the circle already clutching something.

lines.zh: 主人说，从今天起你负责捡。
lines.en: My master said: from today, you do the picking up.

lines.zh: 这具身体的旧主人，早就没了。
lines.en: This body's former owner is long gone.

lines.zh: 第一次睁眼，我就盯上了地上的碎屑。
lines.en: My first sight was a scatter of crumbs on the floor.

lines.zh: 魔精的脑子加人的贪心，拼在一起。
lines.en: A foliot's mind and human greed, stitched together.

lines.zh: 召唤阵收起来时，我已在数掉落物。
lines.en: As the circle closed, I was already counting drops.

lines.zh: 我被塞进戒指，又立刻放出来。
lines.en: I was stuffed into the ring, then let out again.

lines.zh: 刚成形，我就学会了弯腰。
lines.en: Barely formed, I had already learned to bend down.

lines.zh: 主人给我起名，我只记住箱子在哪。
lines.en: My master named me; I only recall where the chest is.

lines.zh: 同类看我一眼，就知道我抢过食。
lines.en: One glance from my kin tells them I have snatched loot.

lines.zh: 我站在阵心，脚边全是灰。
lines.en: I stand in the circle's center, ash all around.

lines.zh: 这副身体是借的，贪婪是自己的。
lines.en: The body is borrowed; the greed is my own.

lines.zh: 火烧到口袋，我拍了两下才灭。
lines.en: Fire caught my pocket and took two slaps to kill.

lines.zh: 摔下来时我先护住怀里的东西。
lines.en: As I fell, I shielded what I held.

lines.zh: 水一灌，我抱着的矿石往下沉。
lines.en: Water pours in and the ore I clutch sinks.

lines.zh: 气浪把袋子掀开，东西飞了一半。
lines.en: The blast tore my bag open and half the loot flew.

lines.zh: 箭擦过耳朵，我缩头继续捡。
lines.en: The arrow grazed my ear; I duck and keep picking.

lines.zh: 药水泼在手上，我抓着的东西滑了。
lines.en: Potion splashed my hand and the loot slipped.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可这具身体在叫。
lines.en: I eat nothing, yet this body keeps complaining.

lines.zh: 雷打在背上，我手里的东西掉了。
lines.en: Lightning hit my back and my hands dropped everything.

lines.zh: 虚空里没东西可捡，我空着手往下掉。
lines.en: Nothing to pick in the void; I fall empty-handed.
